tools.name: preview_entity_lei
tools.description: Free tier: check if a corporate entity has an active GLEIF LEI record.

tools.name: verify_micro_entity
tools.description: Paid x402 micro-tier ($0.02 USDC on Base): instant GLEIF LEI check via POST /v1/verify-micro.

tools.name: verify_single_entity
tools.description: Paid x402 single-tier ($0.05 USDC on Base): enriched GLEIF LEI + parent lineage via POST /v1/verify-single.

tools.name: verify_batch_entities
tools.description: Paid x402 batch-tier ($5.00 USDC on Base): up to 50 entities via POST /v1/verify-batch.

tools.name: verify_institutional_compliance
tools.description: Paid x402 institutional-tier ($50.00 USDC on Base): full compliance verification via POST /v1/institutional-verify.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_micro_entity · Private data: preview_entity_lei · Public sink: verify_micro_entity, verify_single_entity, verify_batch_entities, verify_institutional_compliance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_micro_entity · Private data: preview_entity_lei · Public sink: verify_micro_entity, verify_single_entity, verify_batch_entities, verify_institutional_compliance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
